question: Who among the following was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the **Chairman of the Drafting Committee** of the Constituent Assembly, which was formed on 29 August 1947.
 
• The Drafting Committee was tasked with the crucial responsibility of drafting the **Constitution of India**.
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, also known as the **"Father of the Indian Constitution,"** played a pivotal role in shaping its structure and content.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted on **26 November 1949** and came into effect on **26 January 1950**.
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's intellectual vision and commitment to social justice were instrumental in ensuring that the Constitution emphasized equality, liberty, and fraternity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constituent Assembly:**

 
 
• Formed in **1946**, the Constituent Assembly was tasked with drafting the Constitution of India.
 
• The assembly had **389 members** initially, which was later reduced to 299 after the partition of India.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the **President of the Constituent Assembly.**
 
 
 
• **Drafting Committee:**
 
 
• Composed of **7 members**, the Drafting Committee was chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.
 
• Other notable members included N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar, Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar, and K.M. Munshi.
 
• Its primary role was to prepare the draft Constitution for the Constituent Assembly's consideration.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Indian Constitution:**
 
 
• It is the **longest written Constitution** in the world.
 
• It establishes India as a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic.**
 
• It guarantees fundamental rights such as equality, freedom, and the right against exploitation.
 
 
 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's Legacy:**
 
 
• A social reformer, economist, and jurist, Ambedkar worked tirelessly to uplift marginalized communities in India.
 
• He was a staunch advocate for the abolition of untouchability and the empowerment of women and minorities.
 
• His contributions to the Indian Constitution reflect his commitment to social justice and equality.
